programs.title: Harold And Maude
programs.desc: Harold is a young man obsessed with death, Maude is a septuagenarian with a passion for life. They meet at a funeral. Harold makes Maude laugh with stories about his suicide attempts, she inspires him by stealing the priest's car.

programs.title: The Secret Garden
programs.desc: When Mary Lennox's parents suddenly die, she is sent to live with her uncle, Archibald Craven, on his remote country estate deep in the Yorkshire moors. While exploring, she discovers a hidden magical garden.

programs.title: Mr Blake At Your Service!
programs.desc: A widowed British businessman (John Malkovich) takes the job as a butler of a manor house in France to keep memories of his late French wife. His life takes a turn as he navigates the eccentric behaviour of the lady of the manor and the household staff.

programs.title: The Snows of Kilimanjaro
programs.desc: Gregory Peck heads a celebrated cast that includes Susan Hayward and Ava Gardner in this sweeping film filled with exotic settings – from Africa to Paris to Spain – based on the popular story by Ernest Hemingway. As Harry Street (Peck), a frustrated author/big game hunter, lies dying in the shadow of Africa’s Mount Kilimanjaro, he recounts his goals, his frustrations and his great loves.

programs.title: The Last Castle
programs.desc: The story of a respected and decorated general whose career ends in disgrace when he disobeys orders and is sent to a maximum-security prison dubbed the Castle. Perceiving the injustice at work within the prison system, he rallies his fellow convicts into a rag-tag army and mounts a revolt against the autocratic warden, who runs the institution with an iron fist.

programs.title: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
programs.desc: Film adaptation of John Le Carre's Cold War novel about a retired MI6 agent who must track down a Soviet mole within the British intelligence service's ranks.
